narrative: NII was £15.6M in September against a £16.2M budget and is £4.8M behind year to date; NIM is 3.80% year to date against 3.99%. Variable lending and the BoE reserve account repriced within a month of each Bank Rate cut, while £2.35Bn of fixed-term bonds keep their 4.85% average rate until maturity — the deposit-beta lag. Margin recovery starts in March when £640M of bonds reprice.

signals.title: NIM compression: NII £1.1M behind budget in September
signals.excerpt: Variable lending and BoE reserves repriced after the 2026 Bank Rate cuts; £2.35Bn of fixed-term bonds reprice only on maturity. NIM 3.80% YTD vs 3.99% budget.

signals.title: £640M fixed-term bond maturity wave Dec-26 to Feb-27
signals.excerpt: 27% of the bond book at an average 4.85%. Retention averaged 78% in 2026 vs 85% in the plan.
